method_notes.demand: same quadratic QUAIDS, exact S&Y equation, native pyquaidsce IFGNLS and latent restrictions; no AIDS, uncensored model or curvature restriction
method_notes.elasticity: direct derivative of fitted unconditional quantity x*mu/p; means, CF residuals, weights and other controls fixed
method_notes.inference: point sensitivities only; no final bootstrap or tests that differences between elasticities are statistically significant
method_notes.weighting: yearly survey weight in RF throughout; normalized yearly weights additionally in Probit and IFGNLS only for survey_weighted
method_notes.rf_diagnostic_correction: older fourteenth-suite diagnostic used len(DataFrame) as a column count; restricted equation inadvertently retained current income instruments. RF coefficients/residuals unchanged; this package recalculates the statistic.
